name: What types of roofing materials are available for residential homes?

mainEntity.name: What types of roofing materials are available for residential homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Residential roofing offers a range of materials, each with distinct benefits. Asphalt shingles are popular for their affordability and versatility. Tile roofs, including clay and concrete, offer durability and a distinctive aesthetic. Metal roofing provides longevity and energy efficiency. Other options include wood shakes, slate, and various flat roofing systems for low-slope areas. Your choice depends on budget, climate, and desired appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include asphalt shingles, tile, metal, and wood shakes, each offering different benefits.
